svg.text: Linux Ethernet PHY 软件架构全景图
TCP / UDP / IP / ARP / ICMP / Netfilter
net/ipv4/ net/ipv6/ net/core/dev.c — struct net_device, struct sk_buff
struct phylink_pcs — SerDes / PCS 配置
read(bus, addr, reg) / write(bus, addr, reg, val)
read_c45(bus, addr, devnum, reg) — MMD 寻址
总线扫描 & PHY 发现
PHY 框架 & 驱动层 (PHY Subsystem)
驱动匹配: phy_bus_match() → phy_id_compare(phydev→phy_id, phydrv→phy_id, phydrv→phy_id_mask)
PHY ID 掩码: PHY_ID_MATCH_EXACT(0xFFFFFFFF) / PHY_ID_MATCH_MODEL(0xFFFFFFF0) / PHY_ID_MATCH_VENDOR(0xFFFFFC00)
PHY Address: mdio_device.addr (0~31, 硬件引脚配置) — 设备树: reg = <N> — sysfs: /sys/bus/mdio_bus/devices/bus:XX/
物理介质: Cat5e/Cat6/Cat6a 双绞线 (UTP/STP) │ 单模/多模光纤 │ DAC/AOC 铜缆
├── drivers/net/phy/phy_device.c — PHY 设备注册/探测, genphy_read_status(), PHY ID 读取
├── drivers/net/phy/phy.c — PHY 状态机, phy_start()/phy_stop(), EEE LPI 控制
├── drivers/net/phy/phylink.c — phylink 状态管理, mac_link_up/down 回调, Rate Matching
├── drivers/net/phy/mdio_bus.c — MDIO 总线注册/扫描, mdiobus_read()/write()
└── include/uapi/linux/mii.h — MII 寄存器定义: BMCR/BMSR/PHYSID/ADVERTISE/LPA/CTRL1000
